DECLARE @DimTable varchar(50)  = 'ClientDimension'
DECLARE @DimPrimaryKey varchar(50) = 'ClientID'

DECLARE @DynSQL varchar(MAX) = ''

SET @DynSQL =

'
SELECT 
 CAST(s.' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255))
FROM [stg].[' + @DimTable + '] s
LEFT JOIN [rpt].[' + @DimTable + '] r 
 ON r.ETLHashKey = s.ETLHashKey 
WHERE r.' + @DimPrimaryKey  + ' IS NULL

UNION

SELECT 
 CAST(r.' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255))
FROM [stg].[' + @DimTable +'] s
RIGHT JOIN [rpt].[' + @DimTable + '] r 
 ON r.ETLHashKey = s.ETLHashKey
WHERE CAST(s.' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255)) IS NULL 
 AND r.IsCurrent = ''Y''
'

EXEC (@DynSQL)

'UPDATE rpt.[' + @DimTable + ']
SET IsCurrent = ''N'' WHERE CAST(' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255)) IN 

(SELECT CAST(s.' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255))
FROM [stg].[' + @DimTable + '] s
LEFT JOIN [rpt].[' + @DimTable + '] r ON r.ETLHashKey = s.ETLHashKey 
WHERE r.' + @DimPrimaryKey  + ' IS NULL)'

EXEC (@DynSQL)

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT * , 'Y' AS [IsCurrent] , GETDATE() AS [ETLDateCreated] FROM stg.ClientDimension  WHERE ClientID = ?

DECLARE @DimTable varchar(50)  = 'ClientDimension'
DECLARE @DimPrimaryKey varchar(50) = 'ClientID'


DECLARE @DynSQL varchar(MAX) = ''

SET @DynSQL = 

'UPDATE [rpt].[' + @DimTable + '] SET
IsCurrent = ''N'' WHERE CAST(' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255))  IN (
SELECT CAST(r.' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255))
  FROM [stg].[' + @DimTable +'] s
  RIGHT JOIN [rpt].[' + @DimTable + '] r ON r.ETLHashKey = s.ETLHashKey
  WHERE CAST(s.' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255)) IS NULL AND r.IsCurrent = ''Y''
)'

EXEC (@DynSQL)
